title: Stock market today: Trade setup for Gift Nifty, US-Iran war, USD vs INR to gold, silver rates — 6 stocks to buy or sell | Stock Market News
summary: Indian stock market ended last week under significant corrective pressure amid deteriorating global risk sentiment, rising crude oil prices, and persistent selling by foreign institutional investors. The US-Iran war intensified, triggering broad-based profit-taking across sectors. Gold and silver prices fell amidst geopolitical tensions. Domestic buying interest partially absorbed foreign selling pressure, with Gift Nifty trading green and Asian markets mixed.
sentiment_reason: The market sentiment is negative due to the intensified US-Iran war, rising oil prices, and selling pressure from foreign institutional investors, despite some domestic buying support.
